description:
Productivity analyst that maps your workflow, scores tasks, and builds a
prioritized automation plan. Use when: (1) "audit my workflow", "what should
I automate?", "productivity review", (2) Starting a new project and need to
identify high-leverage tasks, (3) Feeling overwhelmed and need to prioritize,
(4) After /compounder surfaces new friction or patterns.
Reads compounder insights when available. Outputs to system/audit-report.md.
